attributionRules.tokenTotals: inputTokens is non-cached input; totalTokens = input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite. cacheReadFraction denominator is all prompt tokens.
attributionRules.stages: The witness assistant-response timestamp selects one half-open workflow phase window in each native segment; concurrent role responses are associated with the current global phase. Stage elapsed bounds are wall-clock offsets, not model latency; operator wait between the two segments is excluded.
attributionRules.focusedCohorts: Rejected tools are matched by original call+result identities. Each matched response is counted once per cohort. Immediate same-actor response means next model response in the same segment after tool result, whether it repairs, reads, retries or also performs unrelated work. Cohorts and preceding/next may overlap. Deduplicated unions must not be added to each other.
attributionRules.limits: Response usage remains indivisible. These are observed response totals associated with named episodes, not estimates of avoidable tokens, billing, or cache savings.
